# motherduck_flight (Data Source)

Reads metadata for one MotherDuck Flight.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_flight" "daily_load" {
  flight_id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flight_id` (String) Flight ID. Must be a UUID with no leading or trailing whitespace.

### Read-Only

- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.
